correctness.rationale: Complete recursive tree generation by leaf attachment and canonical AHU center codes gives all 201 classes of n<=10. Exact transition implementation realizes closed-neighborhood thresholds 1 and 3 and visits all 2^n states for every class. Functional-digraph trail algorithm enumerates every prime orbit exactly once, producing maxima 1,1,1,1,2,3,6,10,14,22. Unique ten-vertex 22-period tree has two such cycles, with 22 distinct witness states and closed transitions. Published tree-cycle equivalence covers every permutation order. No infinite-range inference made.
